title.purpose: Compact application heading; reduced on narrow screens.

body.purpose: Default interface text and field labels.

background-select-mobile.purpose: Uses 16px select text at widths up to 760px.

gallery-badge.purpose: Tabular preset numbers remain legible over the rendered crosshairs.

shadows.name: tab-indicator
shadows.purpose: Marks the selected settings tab without lifting its surface.

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: Button fill transitions when reduced motion is not requested.

components.name: Primary action button
components.description: Primary Fire action below the live preview.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { font: inherit; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--accent); color: white; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-button:hover { border-color: #114eaa; background: #114eaa; } .ds-primary-button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: wait; } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-primary-button { min-height: 42px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-primary-button { transition: background-color 100ms ease-out; } }

components.name: Neutral button
components.description: Secondary action used for settings and configuration controls.
components.css: .ds-neutral-button { font: inherit; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #b3c2d1; border-radius: 5px; background: #f8fafc; color: #182c41; cursor: pointer; } .ds-neutral-button:hover { background: #dae6f3; } .ds-neutral-button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: wait; } .ds-neutral-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-neutral-button { min-height: 42px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-neutral-button { transition: background-color 100ms ease-out; } }

components.name: Settings tabs
components.description: Four equal-width category tabs; selected state marks the open panel.
components.css: .ds-tabs { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); padding: 8px 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: #f5f8fb; } .ds-tab { min-width: 0; padding: 12px 5px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--accent); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tab-selected, .ds-tab-selected:hover { background: #e1ecf9; color: #114eaa; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--accent); }

components.name: Header navigation
components.description: Quiet links to the Rust API and source repository.
components.css: .ds-header-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-header-nav a { color: #314b64; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-header-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Select field
components.description: Full-width style selector within a settings row.
components.html: <label class="ds-select-label" for="ds-style">Style</label><select class="ds-select" id="ds-style"><option>Dynamic cross</option><option>Static cross</option></select>
components.css: .ds-select-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #182c41; font: inherit; } .ds-select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #b3c2d1; border-radius: 4px; background: white; color: #182c41; font: inherit; accent-color: var(--accent); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Range field
components.description: Label and value sit above a full-width native slider.
components.html: 8
components.css: .ds-range-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px 14px; margin-bottom: 20px; color: #182c41; } .ds-range-field output { color: #39556f; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-range-field input { grid-column: 1 / -1; width: 100%; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); } .ds-range-field label, .ds-range-field input { font: inherit; }

components.name: Hit sound toggle
components.description: Native checkbox with a compact label row.
components.css: .ds-check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #182c41; font: inherit; } .ds-check input { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); } .ds-check input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Configuration field
components.description: Monospace console settings editor with vertical resizing.
components.html: <label class="ds-config-label" for="ds-config">CS2 console settings</label><textarea class="ds-config" id="ds-config" rows="6"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-config-label { display: block; color: #182c41; font: inherit; } .ds-config { width: 100%; margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid #b3c2d1; border-radius: 4px; background: white; color: #233f5a; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-config:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Background selector
components.description: Compact scene selector defaults to Solid, includes ten externally hosted scenes, links the selected source credit, and reports loading or unavailable images.
components.html: Loading background…
components.css: .ds-preview-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-preview-tools label { color: #52667a; font-size: 12px; } .ds-background-select { flex: 1; min-width: 0; max-width: 280px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #b3c2d1; border-radius: 4px; background: white; color: #182c41; font: inherit; } .ds-background-select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-background-credit { color: #175fc3; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-background-credit:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-preview-tools { gap: 8px; } .ds-background-select { font-size: 16px; max-width: none; } } .ds-viewport { position: relative; min-height: 160px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 6px; background: #1a2633 center / cover no-repeat; } .ds-background-status { position: absolute; bottom: 0; margin: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #1a2633; color: #d6e1ee; font-size: 12px; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Live preview
components.description: Canvas and controls share the window-constrained preview row; gallery mode overlays 100 rendered crosshair choices over the selected scene.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-preview { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; flex-direction: column; padding: 24px; background: #e9eff5; } .ds-preview-bar { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-preview-bar output { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-preview-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-preview-tools label { color: #52667a; font-size: 12px; } .ds-background-select { flex: 1; min-width: 0; max-width: 280px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #b3c2d1; border-radius: 4px; background: white; color: #182c41; font: inherit; } .ds-background-select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-background-credit { color: #175fc3; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-background-credit:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3880dd; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-preview-tools { gap: 8px; } .ds-background-select { font-size: 16px; max-width: none; } } .ds-viewport { position: relative; flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 6px; background: #1a2633 center / cover no-repeat; } .ds-viewport canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; } .ds-renderer-loading { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #d6e1ee; pointer-events: none; } .ds-background-status { position: absolute; bottom: 0; margin: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #1a2633; color: #d6e1ee; font-size: 12px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-preview-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 40px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-preview-actions output { margin-left: auto; color: #52667a; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-preview { padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-preview-actions { gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; } }

components.name: Preset gallery selector
components.description: Selection grid overlays the live renderer; a white border marks the selected cell and a white outline marks keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-preset-viewport { position: relative; height: 100%; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; border-radius: 6px; background: #1a2633; } .ds-preset-stage { position: relative; height: 100%; min-height: 600px; } .ds-preset-grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-template-rows: repeat(10, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-preset-cell { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid #ffffff26; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-preset-cell:hover { background: #ffffff14; } .ds-preset-cell[aria-pressed="true"] { border: 2px solid #fff; } .ds-preset-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-preset-badge { padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: #1a2633; color: #fff; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-preset-stage { min-height: 1200px; } .ds-preset-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-template-rows: repeat(20, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

narrative.overview: Crosshair settings stay beside their renderer. The dark preview can use a solid field or one of ten externally hosted scenes. A gallery that fills the preview pane compares 100 crosshairs rendered by Bevy. The pale editor and nearby measurements keep changes and feedback in view.
keyCharacteristics: Pale blue-gray application surfaces frame a dark slate renderer.
Blue marks editor interactions; white outlines mark gallery selection and keyboard focus.
System sans text carries the interface; configuration text uses monospace.
The settings editor groups four categories behind tabs.
The preview offers ten externally hosted scenes with a linked credit.
The gallery compares 100 crosshairs rendered by Bevy against the selected scene.
dos: Do keep the live renderer and its controls immediately available.
Do keep the preview and editor inside the window-constrained grid.
Do keep the settings editor independently scrollable with sticky tabs on desktop and mobile.
Do preserve the 3:2 mobile preview/editor split and the two-column layout for short landscape windows.
Do keep 100 rendered crosshairs in the gallery, with ten desktop columns and five mobile columns.
Do use white borders and focus outlines for gallery selection over the dark renderer.
Do default Background to Solid, show its selected source credit, and keep scene images external.
Do preserve the four settings tabs and their current order.
Do use tabular numerals for FPS, frame time, and hit receipt values.
Do keep configuration text in a monospace field.
donts: Don't use the configurable crosshair or fill color as the editor's interaction accent.
Don't fix the rendered crosshair to the editor's blue palette.
